answer: Each epoch the network issues a per‑identity challenge derived from a procedurally generated ember‑seeded puzzle that maps onto a mesa‑level graph of vine‑linked tasks. An agent must compute a unique solution using its private model state; the puzzle is refreshed every epoch, so replicating identities forces the attacker to run the full model inference for every fake node. The cost scales linearly with the number of Sybils, making large‑scale attacks prohibitively expensive in compute.
